Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.item

Class MeleeWeapon

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.item.Item
com.epitech.depthdiablo.item.Equipment
com.epitech.depthdiablo.item.Weapon
com.epitech.depthdiablo.item.MeleeWeapon
All Implemented Interfaces:
Attack, BuildModifier
Direct Known Subclasses:
Axe, Sword
public abstract class MeleeWeapon extends Weapon
A weapon that hits up close with a blade (GDD 1.6). Its swing is a rotated rectangle (an Obb) as long as the weapon's range, which sweeps an arc around the aim during a few ticks.

The weapon only keeps the fixed size of the blade and how it sweeps. The position and the angle of the blade only exist during a swing, so the Obb is built at each tick of the swing.

  • Constructor Details

    • MeleeWeapon

      protected MeleeWeapon(String id, String nameKey, String spriteId, Rarity rarity, int price, int attackBonus, float attackSpeed, float range, float width, float arcDegrees, int swingTicks)
      Creates a melee weapon.
      Parameters:
      id - the item's key in the data files
      nameKey - the translation key of its name
      spriteId - the picture the renderer draws for it
      rarity - its loot tier; never Rarity.CONSUMABLE
      price - its shop price in coins; 0 means free
      attackBonus - the flat bonus added to the attack in the damage formula; 0 or more
      attackSpeed - its base attack speed; the holder's ATTACK_SPEED stat multiplies it; above 0 and finite
      range - the length of the blade, in pixels; above 0 and finite
      width - the width of the blade, in pixels; above 0 and finite
      arcDegrees - the angle the blade sweeps, centred on the aim; from 0 (a straight thrust) to 360 (a full spin)
      swingTicks - how many ticks one swing lasts; 1 or more
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if a text or the rarity is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if a value of Weapon is wrong, the width is not a finite number above 0, the arc is outside 0 to 360, or the swing lasts less than 1 tick

    • swingShape

      public final Obb swingShape(float pivotX, float pivotY, float aimDegrees, float progress)
      Builds the blade at one moment of a swing. The blade starts at the pivot and points away from it; during the swing it turns from aim - arc/2 to aim + arc/2.
      Parameters:
      pivotX - the x of the point the blade turns around, usually the holder's centre
      pivotY - the y of that point
      aimDegrees - the direction of the attack, in degrees (0 = right, 90 = up)
      progress - how far the swing is, from 0 (start) to 1 (end)
      Returns:
      the blade as a rotated rectangle, Weapon.getRange() long and getWidth() wide
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the pivot or the aim is not finite, or the progress is outside 0 to 1

    • attack

      public final void attack(Character owner, float aimDegrees, World world)
      Starts a swing of this weapon: the owner holds it and runs it during its next updates, and cannot attack again until the swing and then its cooldown are over (DECISIONS §5). Either all of it happens or nothing does: a wrong argument leaves the owner's cooldown untouched.
      Parameters:
      owner - the character who swings; it must be able to attack now
      aimDegrees - the direction of the attack, in degrees (0 = right, 90 = up)
      world - its entities are the targets of the blade, its event bus gets the damage and deaths
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the aim is not a finite number
      IllegalStateException - if the owner cannot attack now (see Character.canAttack())
